SPACING.$description: 8px base grid spacing scale (unitless density-independent pixels).

LAYOUT.$description: Screen layout constants (unitless density-independent pixels, plus the cardAspectRatio ratio).

TOUCH_TARGET.$description: Minimum touch target sizes for accessibility (unitless density-independent pixels).

min.$description: 48x48 minimum: the max of Apple HIG 44pt and Material 48dp, and on the 8pt grid (cardi-design-system.md, Layout & Spacing). There is no watch key: both watch apps are Swift and Kotlin and cannot read this token (cardi-watch-grammar.md §5.4).
